*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: eza_py/options.py
+"""Command-line parsing and option deduction compatible with eza v0.23.3."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+import json
+import os
+import shutil
+from typing import Iterable, Mapping, Sequence
+
+
+WHEN = ("always", "auto", "never")
+SORT_CHOICES = (
+    "name",
+    "Name",
+    "size",
+    "extension",
+    "Extension",
+    "modified",
+    "changed",
+    "accessed",
+    "created",
+    "inode",
+    "type",
+    "none",
+)
+TIME_CHOICES = ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created")
+TIME_STYLE_CHOICES = ("default", "long-iso", "full-iso", "iso", "relative")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class FlagSpec:
+    long: str
+    short: str | None = None
+    value: str = "forbidden"
+    choices: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
+    default: str | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def display(self) -> str:
+        suffix = f" (-{self.short})" if self.short else ""
+        return f"--{self.long}{suffix}"
+
+
+def _specs() -> tuple[FlagSpec, ...]:
+    f = FlagSpec
+    return (
+        f("version", "v"), f("help", "?"),
+        f("oneline", "1"), f("long", "l"), f("grid", "G"),
+        f("across", "x"), f("recurse", "R"), f("tree", "T"),
+        f("classify", "F", "optional", WHEN, "auto"),
+        f("dereference", "X"), f("width", "w", "necessary"),
+        f("no-quotes"),
+        f("absolute", None, "optional", ("on", "follow", "off"), "on"),
+        f("follow-symlinks"),
+        f("color", None, "optional", WHEN, "auto"),
+        f("colour", None, "optional", WHEN, "auto"),
+        f("color-scale", None, "optional", ("all", "size", "age"), "all"),
+        f("colour-scale", None, "optional", ("all", "size", "age"), "all"),
+        f("color-scale-mode", None, "necessary", ("fixed", "gradient")),
+        f("colour-scale-mode", None, "necessary", ("fixed", "gradient")),
+        f("all", "a"), f("almost-all", "A"),
+        f("treat-dirs-as-files", "d"), f("list-dirs"),
+        f("level", "L", "necessary"), f("reverse", "r"),
+        f("sort", "s", "necessary", SORT_CHOICES),
+        f("ignore-glob", "I", "necessary"), f("git-ignore"),
+        f("group-directories-first"), f("group-directories-last"),
+        f("only-dirs", "D"), f("only-files", "f"),
+        f("no-symlinks"), f("show-symlinks"),
+        f("binary", "b"), f("bytes", "B"), f("group", "g"),
+        f("numeric", "n"), f("header", "h"),
+        f("icons", None, "optional", WHEN, "auto"),
+        f("inode", "i"), f("links", "H"), f("modified", "m"),
+        f("changed"), f("blocksize", "S"), f("total-size"),
+        f("time", "t", "necessary", TIME_CHOICES), f("accessed", "u"),
+        f("created", "U"),
+        f("time-style", None, "necessary", TIME_STYLE_CHOICES),
+        f("hyperlink"), f("mounts", "M"), f("smart-group"),
+        f("no-permissions"), f("no-filesize"), f("no-user"), f("no-time"),
+        f("git"), f("no-git"), f("git-repos"), f("git-repos-no-status"),
+        f("extended", "@"), f("octal-permissions", "o"),
+        f("context", "Z"), f("stdin"), f("flags", "O"),
+    )
+
+
+SPECS = _specs()
+LONG_FLAGS = {spec.long: spec for spec in SPECS}
+SHORT_FLAGS = {spec.short: spec for spec in SPECS if spec.short is not None}
+
+
+class OptionError(Exception):
+    """An error whose message follows eza's option-error contract."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Occurrence:
+    spec: FlagSpec
+    spelling: str
+    value: str | None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Matches:
+    flags: list[Occurrence]
+    paths: list[str]
+
+    def occurrences(self, name: str) -> list[Occurrence]:
+        return [flag for flag in self.flags if flag.spec.long == name]
+
+    def has(self, name: str) -> bool:
+        return any(flag.spec.long == name for flag in self.flags)
+
+    def count(self, name: str) -> int:
+        return sum(flag.spec.long == name for flag in self.flags)
+
+    def get(self, name: str) -> str | None:
+        for flag in reversed(self.flags):
+            if flag.spec.long == name:
+                return flag.value
+        return None
+
+    def last_of(self, names: Iterable[str]) -> Occurrence | None:
+        wanted = set(names)
+        return next(
+            (flag for flag in reversed(self.flags) if flag.spec.long in wanted),
+            None,
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Options:
+    paths: list[str]
+    special: str | None
+    view: str
+    width: int | None
+    across: bool
+    recurse: bool
+    tree: bool
+    max_depth: int | None
+    treat_dirs_as_files: bool
+    sort: str
+    reverse: bool
+    dirs_first: bool
+    dirs_last: bool
+    dot_mode: int
+    only_dirs: bool
+    only_files: bool
+    no_symlinks: bool
+    show_symlinks: bool
+    ignore_globs: tuple[str, ...]
+    classify: str
+    quote: bool
+    absolute: str
+    dereference: bool
+    follow_symlinks: bool
+    header: bool
+    size_format: str
+    permissions: bool
+    filesize: bool
+    file_flags: bool
+    time_types: tuple[str, ...]
+    time_style: str
+    stdin_mode: bool
+    stdin_separator: str
+    hyperlink: bool
+    total_size: bool
+
+    @property
+    def long_view(self) -> bool:
+        return self.view in ("details", "grid-details") and not (
+            self.tree and self.view == "details" and not self.time_types
+        )
+
+
+def _flag_label(spelling: str) -> str:
+    return spelling
+
+
+def _needs_value(spec: FlagSpec, spelling: str) -> OptionError:
+    choices = ""
+    if spec.choices:
+        choices = f" (choices: {', '.join(spec.choices)})"
+    return OptionError(f"Flag {_flag_label(spelling)} needs a value{choices}")
+
+
+def parse_args(argv: Sequence[str]) -> Matches:
+    flags: list[Occurrence] = []
+    paths: list[str] = []
+    parsing = True
+    index = 0
+
+    while index < len(argv):
+        token = argv[index]
+        index += 1
+        if not parsing:
+            paths.append(token)
+            continue
+        if token == "--":
+            parsing = False
+            continue
+        if token.startswith("--"):
+            raw = token[2:]
+            if "=" in raw:
+                name, supplied = raw.split("=", 1)
+                spec = LONG_FLAGS.get(name)
+                if spec is None:
+                    raise OptionError(f"Unknown argument --{name}")
+                spelling = f"--{name}"
+                if spec.value == "forbidden":
+                    raise OptionError(f"Flag {spelling} cannot take a value")
+                flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, supplied))
+                continue
+
+            spec = LONG_FLAGS.get(raw)
+            if spec is None:
+                raise OptionError(f"Unknown argument --{raw}")
+            spelling = f"--{raw}"
+            if spec.value == "forbidden":
+                flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, None))
+            elif spec.value == "necessary":
+                if index >= len(argv):
+                    raise _needs_value(spec, spelling)
+                flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, argv[index]))
+                index += 1
+            elif index < len(argv) and spec.choices and argv[index] in spec.choices:
+                flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, argv[index]))
+                index += 1
+            else:
+                flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, spec.default))
+            continue
+
+        if token.startswith("-") and token != "-":
+            raw = token[1:]
+            if "=" in raw:
+                before, supplied = raw.split("=", 1)
+                if not before:
+                    paths.append(token)
+                    continue
+                for char in before[:-1]:
+                    spec = SHORT_FLAGS.get(char)
+                    if spec is None:
+                        raise OptionError(f"Unknown argument -{char}")
+                    spelling = f"-{char}"
+                    if spec.value == "necessary":
+                        raise _needs_value(spec, spelling)
+                    value = spec.default if spec.value == "optional" else None
+                    flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, value))
+                char = before[-1]
+                spec = SHORT_FLAGS.get(char)
+                if spec is None:
+                    raise OptionError(f"Unknown argument -{char}")
+                spelling = f"-{char}"
+                if spec.value == "forbidden":
+                    raise OptionError(f"Flag {spelling} cannot take a value")
+                flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, supplied))
+                continue
+
+            char_index = 0
+            while char_index < len(raw):
+                char = raw[char_index]
+                spec = SHORT_FLAGS.get(char)
+                if spec is None:
+                    raise OptionError(f"Unknown argument -{char}")
+                spelling = f"-{char}"
+                if spec.value == "forbidden":
+                    flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, None))
+                    char_index += 1
+                    continue
+                remnants = raw[char_index + 1 :]
+                if spec.value == "necessary":
+                    if remnants:
+                        flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, remnants))
+                    elif index < len(argv):
+                        flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, argv[index]))
+                        index += 1
+                    else:
+                        raise _needs_value(spec, spelling)
+                    break
+                if remnants:
+                    if spec.choices and remnants in spec.choices:
+                        flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, remnants))
+                    else:
+                        raise OptionError(f"Flag {spelling} cannot take a value")
+                    break
+                if index < len(argv) and spec.choices and argv[index] in spec.choices:
+                    flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, argv[index]))
+                    index += 1
+                else:
+                    flags.append(Occurrence(spec, spelling, spec.default))
+                break
+            continue
+
+        paths.append(token)
+
+    return Matches(flags, paths)
+
+
+def _debug(value: str) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
+
+
+def _bad(spec_name: str, value: str, choices: bool = False) -> OptionError:
+    spec = LONG_FLAGS[spec_name]
+    suffix = ""
+    if choices and spec.choices:
+        suffix = f" (choices: {', '.join(spec.choices)})"
+    return OptionError(
+        f"Option {spec.display} has no {_debug(value)} setting{suffix}"
+    )
+
+
+def _parse_usize(value: str, spec_name: str) -> int:
+    if not value:
+        reason = "cannot parse integer from empty string"
+    elif not value.isascii() or not value.isdigit():
+        reason = "invalid digit found in string"
+    else:
+        number = int(value)
+        if number <= (1 << 64) - 1:
+            return number
+        reason = "number too large to fit in target type"
+    spec = LONG_FLAGS[spec_name]
+    raise OptionError(
+        f"Value {_debug(value)} not valid for option {spec.display}: {reason}"
+    )
+
+
+def _terminal_width(stdout_isatty: bool) -> int | None:
+    if not stdout_isatty:
+        return None
+    return shutil.get_terminal_size(fallback=(80, 24)).columns
+
+
+def deduce_options(
+    argv: Sequence[str],
+    env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
+    *,
+    stdout_isatty: bool = False,
+    stdin_isatty: bool = False,
+) -> Options:
+    environment = os.environ if env is None else env
+    matches = parse_args(argv)
+    if matches.has("help"):
+        return _special(matches.paths, "help")
+    if matches.has("version"):
+        return _special(matches.paths, "version")
+
+    width_word = matches.get("width")
+    width: int | None
+    if width_word is not None:
+        parsed_width = _parse_usize(width_word, "width")
+        width = parsed_width if parsed_width >= 1 else _terminal_width(stdout_isatty)
+    elif "COLUMNS" in environment:
+        width = _parse_usize(environment["COLUMNS"], "width")
+    else:
+        width = _terminal_width(stdout_isatty)
+
+    view_flag = matches.last_of(("long", "oneline", "grid", "tree"))
+    if view_flag is None:
+        view = "grid" if width is not None else "lines"
+    elif view_flag.spec.long == "long" or (
+        view_flag.spec.long in ("tree", "grid") and matches.has("long")
+    ):
+        grid_or_tree = matches.last_of(("grid", "tree"))
+        view = (
+            "grid-details"
+            if grid_or_tree is not None and grid_or_tree.spec.long == "grid"
+            else "details"
+        )
+    elif view_flag.spec.long == "tree":
+        view = "details"
+    elif view_flag.spec.long == "oneline":
+        view = "lines"
+    else:
+        view = "grid"
+
+    can_tree = view == "details"
+    tree = matches.has("tree") and can_tree
+    recurse = tree or matches.has("recurse")
+    as_file = matches.has("treat-dirs-as-files") or matches.has("list-dirs")
+    treat_dirs = tree or (not recurse and as_file)
+    max_depth = None
+    if recurse and matches.get("level") is not None:
+        max_depth = _parse_usize(matches.get("level") or "", "level")
+
+    all_count = matches.count("all")
+    if tree and all_count >= 2:
+        raise OptionError("Option --tree is useless given --all --all")
+    if all_count >= 2:
+        dot_mode = 2
+    elif all_count or matches.has("almost-all"):
+        dot_mode = 1
+    else:
+        dot_mode = 0
+
+    sort_word = matches.get("sort") or "name"
+    sort_aliases = {
+        "filename": "name", "Filename": "Name",
+        ".filename": ".name", ".Filename": ".Name",
+        "filesize": "size", "ext": "extension", "Ext": "Extension",
+        "date": "modified", "time": "modified", "mod": "modified",
+        "new": "modified", "newest": "modified",
+        "age": "age", "old": "age", "oldest": "age",
+        "ch": "changed", "acc": "accessed", "cr": "created",
+    }
+    sort_word = sort_aliases.get(sort_word, sort_word)
+    valid_sorts = {
+        "name", "Name", ".name", ".Name", "size", "extension",
+        "Extension", "modified", "age", "changed", "accessed",
+        "created", "inode", "type", "none",
+    }
+    if sort_word not in valid_sorts or (os.name == "nt" and sort_word == "inode"):
+        raise _bad("sort", matches.get("sort") or sort_word, choices=True)
+
+    classify = matches.get("classify") or "never"
+    if classify == "automatic":
+        classify = "auto"
+    if classify not in WHEN:
+        raise _bad("classify", classify)
+
+    absolute = matches.get("absolute") or "off"
+    absolute = {"yes": "on", "no": "off"}.get(absolute, absolute)
+    if absolute not in ("on", "follow", "off"):
+        raise _bad("absolute", absolute)
+
+    color_occurrence = matches.last_of(("color", "colour"))
+    if color_occurrence is not None:
+        color = color_occurrence.value or "auto"
+        if color == "automatic":
+            color = "auto"
+        if color not in WHEN:
+            raise _bad("color", color)
+
+    icons = matches.get("icons")
+    if icons is not None:
+        if icons == "automatic":
+            icons = "auto"
+        if icons not in WHEN:
+            raise _bad("icons", icons)
+
+    scale_mode = matches.last_of(("color-scale-mode", "colour-scale-mode"))
+    if scale_mode is not None and scale_mode.value not in ("fixed", "gradient"):
+        raise _bad("color-scale-mode", scale_mode.value or "")
+    scale = matches.last_of(("color-scale", "colour-scale"))
+    if scale is not None:
+        for word in (scale.value or "").split(","):
+            if word not in ("all", "age", "size"):
+                raise _bad("color-scale", word)
+
+    ignore_word = matches.get("ignore-glob")
+    ignore_globs = tuple(ignore_word.split("|")) if ignore_word is not None else ()
+
+    long_table = view in ("details", "grid-details") and not (
+        tree and not matches.has("long")
+    )
+    size_format = "decimal"
+    size_occurrence = matches.last_of(("binary", "bytes"))
+    if long_table and size_occurrence is not None:
+        size_format = "binary" if size_occurrence.spec.long == "binary" else "bytes"
+
+    time_types: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+    time_style = "default"
+    if long_table:
+        if matches.has("no-time"):
+            time_types = ()
+        elif matches.get("time") is not None:
+            word = matches.get("time") or ""
+            aliases = {"mod": "modified", "ch": "changed", "acc": "accessed", "cr": "created"}
+            word = aliases.get(word, word)
+            if word not in TIME_CHOICES:
+                raise _bad("time", matches.get("time") or "", choices=True)
+            time_types = (word,)
+        else:
+            selected = tuple(
+                name for name in ("modified", "changed", "created", "accessed")
+                if matches.has(name)
+            )
+            time_types = selected or ("modified",)
+
+        style_word = matches.get("time-style")
+        if style_word is None:
+            style_word = environment.get("TIME_STYLE") or "default"
+        if style_word not in TIME_STYLE_CHOICES and not style_word.startswith("+"):
+            raise _bad("time-style", style_word, choices=True)
+        time_style = style_word
+
+    stdin_mode = matches.has("stdin") or not stdin_isatty
+    return Options(
+        paths=matches.paths,
+        special=None,
+        view=view,
+        width=width,
